title: Cybersecurity and cyber resilience policy
summary: A Board or partner-approved cybersecurity and cyber resilience policy covering CSCRF requirements, reviewed periodically.

title: Roles, CISO and oversight committee
summary: A designated CISO (or equivalent, per RE category), defined cybersecurity roles, and oversight by a technology or IT committee and senior management.
typical_evidence: CISO designation; committee terms of reference and minutes

title: Cyber risk management
summary: A cyber risk management framework with periodic risk assessments and risk treatment.
typical_evidence: Risk methodology; risk assessment; risk register

title: Third-party and supply chain risk
summary: Risk-based management of third-party service providers, including contracts, due diligence, monitoring and software bill of materials (SBOM) for critical software.
typical_evidence: Vendor inventory and assessments; contract clauses; SBOMs

title: Cloud adoption
summary: Cloud services are used in line with SEBI's cloud framework (data location, provider due diligence, security responsibilities).
typical_evidence: Cloud framework compliance mapping; provider assessments

title: Asset inventory and critical systems
summary: An inventory of IT assets, data and applications, with critical systems identified and classified.

title: Cyber Capability Index
summary: Market infrastructure institutions and qualified REs assess their cyber resilience with the Cyber Capability Index at the required frequency.
typical_evidence: Only for MIIs and qualified REs: CCI assessment

title: Access control and authentication
summary: Least privilege, periodic access reviews, MFA, and privileged access management for critical systems.

title: Data protection and localisation
summary: Data classification; encryption at rest and in transit; data stored and processed within India where CSCRF or SEBI circulars require it.

title: Application and API security
summary: A secure SDLC, application and API security testing, and secure configuration of systems.
typical_evidence: SDLC policy; security test results; API security controls

title: Patch and vulnerability management
summary: Timely patching and vulnerability management, with remediation timelines by severity.

title: Awareness and training
summary: Cybersecurity awareness and training for staff, management and relevant third parties.

title: Logging and log retention
summary: Logs of critical systems are collected centrally, protected and retained in India for the period CSCRF requires (verify the current period).
typical_evidence: Log configuration; retention settings; storage region

title: Security operations centre
summary: Continuous monitoring through an own, group or market SOC (as allowed by RE category), with SOC efficacy measured.
typical_evidence: SOC arrangement; monitoring coverage; efficacy reports

title: VAPT
summary: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing at the frequency required for the RE category; findings closed within the prescribed timelines and reported.
typical_evidence: VAPT reports; closure evidence; submissions to SEBI

title: Incident response and reporting
summary: An incident response plan; cyber incidents reported to SEBI and CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing, with follow-up reports.

title: Cyber crisis management plan
summary: A cyber crisis management plan approved by the Board or committee and tested periodically.

title: Business continuity and DR
summary: BCP and DR for critical systems, with defined RTO and RPO and periodic DR drills.
typical_evidence: BCP and DR plans; drill reports

title: Root cause analysis and recovery
summary: Root cause analysis after incidents, with corrective actions tracked to closure.

title: Cybersecurity audit
summary: Cybersecurity audits by a CERT-In empanelled auditor at the frequency for the RE category, with findings and compliance submitted to SEBI.

title: Periodic compliance reporting
summary: CSCRF compliance is reported to SEBI or the relevant market infrastructure institution in the prescribed format and frequency.
